description: No clean board pattern found. U49 tends to fire on sparse, early positions (about 4-14 stones, no column taller than 4, no full column), more often when column 1 is still empty, but whether it fires depends on the exact placement of individual stones and on the opponent's last move in ways that do not reduce to a simple rule. Full or nearly full boards almost never fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing the unit to its maximum or to zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.01 on three positions tested.
notes: 5 score calls. Sparse-board rule (max height<=4, ply<=16): F1 0.103, AUROC 0.662, sim share 0.02. Adding col-1-empty: F1 0.121 (best), AUROC 0.597. Last-row/no-threat, O-capping and ply-only variants were no better. Minimal pairs show swings >1.5 from moving one stone, inconsistent in direction across bases; deep-well and full-column hypotheses rejected. Likely a distributed/mixture direction. Synthesis reached 2.004 (dev max 1.895) via hill-climb: my stacked col-5 pair and col-3 stone each capped by O.
